# SafeBed Pilot Area Selection Scorecard v0.1

**Purpose:** compare potential local discovery areas without selecting on publicity, headline homelessness numbers or access to live data.

This public template must not contain private contact details, unpublished partner assessments, identifiable service-user information or confidential council/provider information.

## Scoring

Use:

- `0` — absent / serious barrier
- `1` — weak
- `2` — workable
- `3` — strong
- `?` — not yet known

Unknowns should remain `?`; do not convert missing information into an optimistic score.

## Essential operating criteria

| Criterion | Score | Public-safe evidence / question |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Identifiable homelessness/housing operational owner | `?` | Who owns the real same-night process? |
| Willingness to map actual rather than idealised workflow | `?` | Can frontline/out-of-hours steps be included? |
| Information-governance participation available | `?` | Can IG/data-protection roles join before live data? |
| Safeguarding participation available | `?` | Can protected/specialist pathways be reviewed? |
| Digital/system ownership identifiable | `?` | Who owns council/integration systems? |
| Provider network sufficiently varied for discovery | `?` | Are several materially different workflows present? |
| Synthetic-first discovery acceptable | `?` | Can initial work proceed with no real referral data? |
| Existing statutory/provider decisions can remain authoritative | `?` | Is SafeBed allowed to integrate rather than replace? |

**Essential subtotal:** `?/24`

A candidate with a `0` in governance/safeguarding/synthetic-first criteria should normally be paused regardless of total score.

## Discovery-value criteria

| Criterion | Score | Public-safe evidence / question |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Meaningful out-of-hours placement challenge | `?` | Is same-night availability/referral genuinely difficult? |
| Mix of manual and digital provider workflows | `?` | Can interoperability assumptions be stress-tested? |
| Frontline/outreach organisations willing to contribute | `?` | Can referral-side workflow be represented? |
| Potential specialist/protected-service design input | `?` | Can safeguarding be challenged without sharing protected data? |
| Existing use/interest in open service data | `?` | Is there useful standards/data-sharing experience? |
| Willingness to establish baseline measures | `?` | Can the pilot measure process before/after rather than only demo software? |
| Practical geographic/provider scope | `?` | Is the area small enough to learn but varied enough to challenge the model? |

**Discovery subtotal:** `?/21`

## Delivery-risk criteria

Score `0` for low risk and `3` for high risk.

| Risk | Score | Public-safe evidence / question |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Pressure to use live personal data before governance is ready | `?` | Any expectation of early production data? |
| Pressure to skip provider/safeguarding assessment | `?` | Would speed be prioritised over existing admission controls? |
| Requirement to replace major incumbent systems | `?` | Is interoperability unacceptable to the area? |
| Only one homogeneous provider workflow available | `?` | Would the pilot fail to test interoperability? |
| No safe/manual fallback for out-of-hours failure | `?` | What happens if SafeBed/integration is unavailable? |
| Publicity/procurement pressure before discovery | `?` | Is there pressure to promise outcomes too early? |

**Risk subtotal:** `?/18` — lower is better.

## Decision

Choose one:

- `DO_NOT_APPROACH YET`
- `DISCOVERY CONVERSATION ONLY`
- `CANDIDATE FOR SYNTHETIC WORKFLOW MAPPING`
- `CANDIDATE FOR GOVERNANCE ASSESSMENT`

A high score does **not** authorise live data or a live pilot.

## Selection principle

The best initial area is not necessarily the largest or most digitally mature.

Prefer the area most able to help answer:

> **Can SafeBed reduce same-night placement friction across materially different providers without creating duplicate administration, weakening safeguarding or pretending uncertain capacity is live?**
